meta.title: The Village - Family Club · Pilates and movement for parents in Saigon
meta.description: Pilates, yoga, strength, fitness and dance for parents, with your little ones close by. Open play and private hire too. An Khánh, Hồ Chí Minh.

site.heroTitle: pilates and movement for mums and little ones
site.heroLead: Move. Connect. Belong. Bring your children along.
site.villageTitle: it takes a village to raise a child
site.villageStrong: Parents shouldn't have to choose between looking after themselves and their children.
site.villageBody: So we built exercise around parenthood: proper classes, with your little ones playing, exploring or simply close by. Not a gym, not a play centre. A place designed with you in mind.

move.title: move
move.body: Pilates, yoga, strength, fitness and dance, worth doing in their own right.

connect.title: connect
connect.body: Children stay close. Meet parents at your stage over coffee, workshops and events.

belong.title: belong
belong.body: Made for this stage of life. Arrive with your baby, no awkwardness. You belong here.

site.welcomeAll: Made with mums and young children in mind. Dads, expectant parents and families are welcome too.

classes.title: Classes
classes.body: Core & Cuddle, Mum & Bub Yoga and Wiggle & Wonder.

openPlay.title: Open play
openPlay.body: Play time for parents and kids.

hire.title: Private hire
hire.body: Hire the whole studio: message us on WhatsApp or Zalo.

site.comingSoon: Coming soon: workshops on parenting and baby health and safety, and events for the whole family.
